Emma: Quick kickoff 1 We have the launch post + webinars next week. Need final copy pass for the three landing pages (Hosted API, Dedicated, Private) and a clear lead routing plan.

Noah: Understood. Which page drives trial vs sales vs enterprise?

Emma: Hosted -> self-serve trial. Dedicated -> sales-led demo / capacity request. Private -> enterprise contact, gated assets.

Maya: I'll tighten hero microcopy. Goal: 2-3 words in hero, one-line subhead, three benefit bullets max, one primary CTA. Will propose variants.

Zach: Design callout: use a single hero layout with content toggle by mode. Keeps page frame consistent and makes A/B easy.

Liza: Routing summary: Hosted -> /signup (trial funnel); Dedicated -> /contact-sales (SF queue + Calendly for demos); Private -> gated form + datasheet email. Will add UTMs and conversion events.

Emma: @Liza paste exact UTM & SF queue names here. Also need webhook verification for Dedicated leads.

Liza: UTMs: Hosted: /signup?utm_source=launch_post&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=onramp_hosted Dedicated: /contact-sales?utm_source=launch_post&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=onramp_dedicated Private: /enterprise-contact?utm_source=launch_post&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=onramp_private

Noah: For Dedicated SF: queue name "Dedicated_Inbound"; lead tags: product=dedicated, source=onramp_launch. @ops-bot can you check webhook?

ops-bot: Check complete: Salesforce queue "Dedicated_Inbound" exists. Webhook endpoint: https://hooks.redwood.internal/sf/dedicated_inbound. Auth token expires in 29 days. :white_check_mark:

Maya: Draft CTAs: Hosted: "Start free trial" / "Try Hosted API" Dedicated: "Book throughput demo" / "Request dedicated capacity" Private: "Contact enterprise team" / "Request privacy datasheet"

Zach: Prefer consistent verbs: "Try Hosted API", "Book throughput demo", "Contact enterprise team". Short and actionable.

Emma: Webinar plan: Tue launch post; Wed Hosted quickstart webinar (20m + Q); Thu Dedicated/Private deep dive (30m, SRE + Sales). CTAs should link to webinar where appropriate.

Liza: Mapping: Hosted hero primary -> /signup with UTM. Hosted secondary -> /webinar/hosted-onramp?utm_campaign=hosted_webinar Dedicated primary -> Calendly link (tag SF); secondary -> /docs/dedicated-brief Private primary -> enterprise form; secondary -> request datasheet (gated).

Maya: First draft microcopy (short): Hosted: Hero: "Generate in minutes." Subhead: "Hosted API: streaming, predictable performance." Bullets: "Low-latency SLOs" / "Per-token cost controls" / "Automatic caching & batching" CTA: "Try Hosted API" Dedicated: Hero: "Reserved capacity for production." Subhead: "Predictable throughput, SLA options." Bullets: "Guaranteed throughput" / "Autoscale & burst" / "Dedicated pricing contact" CTA: "Book throughput demo" Private: Hero: "Run inference in your network." Subhead: "VPC or on-prem with enterprise controls." Bullets: "KMS/HSM integrations" / "Audit-ready logs" / "Custom deployment models" CTA: "Contact enterprise team"

Emma: Tighten Hosted subhead to "Fast setup, predictable performance." Remove an extra bullet. Dedicated add explicit line about pricing contact. Private emphasize "compliant by design."

Maya: Will post revised copy shortly.

Zach: I'll prepare a single Figma file with three hero states and responsive breakpoints by tomorrow morning.

Noah: I'll prepare Dedicated demo script + bench numbers (throughput, p50/p90 latency, cost per 1k tokens) and share slide snippet for the brief.

Liza: I'll wire UTMs, create SF mappings, and run webhook test. Will paste test logs when done.

ops-bot: Reminder set: "Landing copy freeze" 24 hours before 2981310967.

Emma: Assignments: Maya (copy) EOD today; Zach (design) 10am tomorrow; Liza (routing/UTMs) EOD; Noah (demo & SF mapping) EOD. Keep CTAs mode-specific. :rocket:

Maya: I'll drop the updated hero + alt CTAs in this thread in an hour.
